§6PUREX Reprocessing Plant§f

§aDon't throw away spent fuel. The PUREX turns nuclear waste into profit.§f

The §bPUREX§f (Plutonium Uranium Reduction EXtraction) is a 5×5×5 pseudo-multiblock that reprocesses depleted fuel into useful materials. Most recipes need §bNitric Acid§f and §bKerosene§f.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Machine, 15s, 100 HE/t):
§b•§f 4× Steel Shell, 8× Rubber Pipe, 4× Cast Lead Plate, 4× Desh Motor, 4× Integrated Circuit Board

§6What It Can Reprocess§f:
§b•§f §bDepleted ZIRNOX, PWR, Watz§f and §bPlate Fuel§f
§b•§f §bDepleted Liquid Thorium Salt§f
§b•§f §bDepleted ICF Fuel Pellets§f
§b•§f §bVitrify Nuclear Waste§f into glass
§b•§f §bExtract Schrabidium§f from schraranium, ZIRNOX Pu fuel, and PWR MEP/MEN fuel (requires Schrabidic Acid, yields §e2×§f the input)

§6GUI§f: 3 input slots + 3 fluid inputs, 6 output slots + 1 fluid output, §e1.0 MHE§f buffer. Template button selects recipe.

§6Auto Switch Groups§f: 5 groups that change recipe based on input, ZIRNOX, Plate, PWR, Watz, and Schrabidium Extraction.

§ePS:§f The PUREX is expensive but pays for itself fast. Every piece of spent fuel you reprocess is material you don't have to mine or breed.
